apiKeys.createdDescription: Copy this key now — for security, it will not be shown again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
apiKeys.integrationDescription: Credentials for an external website or system to use Ahemad's Restro as a backend — browse the menu, place orders, and book tables for a location. Not tied to any staff account.
apiKeys.locationHelp: Scope this key to one location, or leave it as all locations for a key a central booking widget can use across every branch.
apiKeys.mcpHeaderBefore: Point your MCP client at that URL with header
apiKeys.personalDescription: Personal access tokens that act as you, with your exact permissions. Use one to connect an MCP client (Claude Desktop, etc.) or any script.
apiKeys.personalHelp: This key lets an AI client (like Claude Desktop) or any script act as you, with your exact permissions — see the MCP connection details below once created.
apiKeys.revokeIntegrationConfirm: Revoke "{name}"? Any external website using this key stops working immediately.
apiKeys.revokePersonalConfirm: Revoke "{name}"? Anything using this key stops working immediately.

backup.description: Scheduled database backups to this deployment's Cloudflare R2 bucket — nothing to connect and no keys to enter. This is deployment-wide: it covers every restaurant on this deployment, not just yours.
backup.destination: Stored in this deployment's Cloudflare R2 bucket
backup.downloadDescription: Save a complete copy of the database to this computer as a compressed .ndjson.gz file (a logical export of every table). Menu photos, logos and documents stay in Cloudflare R2 and are not included. Contains customer and sales data, so store it safely.
backup.drPortable: The backups on this page are an extra, portable copy you can download and keep offline.
backup.drTimeTravel: The primary recovery path is Cloudflare D1 Time Travel: the database can be restored to any point in the last 30 days. It runs automatically and is restored by whoever manages this Cloudflare deployment (wrangler d1 time-travel restore).
backup.emptyDescription: Back up now to create the first one, or wait for the next scheduled run.
backup.resetConfirm: Reset the backup schedule to the deployment defaults?
backup.restoreDone: Restore completed — the database was reverted to this backup
backup.restoreHelp: Restoring replaces the whole database with the chosen backup. Downloads are .ndjson.gz files.
backup.restoreOwnerOnly: Only the Owner can restore a backup.
backup.restoreWarning: This overwrites the entire database — for every restaurant on this deployment — with the contents of the backup taken {date}. Photos and documents stored in R2 are not touched. This cannot be undone.
backup.scheduleHelp: Choose how often a backup runs and how many verified backups to keep in R2. Older ones are deleted automatically.
backup.scheduleSaveFailed: Could not save the backup schedule
backup.title: Backup & restore

printer.cloudNote: This edition runs on Cloudflare, not on a computer in your restaurant. Browser printing (the print button on receipts and tickets) is the recommended way to print. USB printers cannot be used from the cloud, and a network printer only works if it is reachable from the internet (public address or port forwarding on port 9100).
printer.description: Native ESC/POS printing, independent of the browser print dialog. The server sends the job straight to the printer, so the printer must be reachable from the server.
printer.drawerFailed: Could not open the cash drawer
printer.drawerHelp: The drawer must be plugged into the printer’s drawer (RJ11) port. Receipts printed directly to the printer for cash payments open it automatically.
printer.kotFailed: Could not print the sample kitchen ticket
printer.networkCloudHint: Enter the printer's public address (or your router's address with port forwarding). Local addresses such as 192.168.x.x are not reachable from Cloudflare.
printer.networkHint: For a network printer, enter its address below and save it, then choose Network.
printer.testFailed: Could not print a test slip
printer.textHelp: Text is sent as native printer text, not an image. Run “Send test print” after changing these: the ruler line should fill one line exactly and the accents line should read correctly.
printer.title: Thermal printer (receipts & kitchen tickets)
printer.usbCloudWarning: USB printing does not work on the Cloudflare edition: there is no server in your restaurant to plug the printer into. Use browser printing, or a network printer reachable from the internet.

verifactu.description: Every paid sale becomes a simplified invoice in a tamper-evident chain with a QR code on the receipt, and is reported to the Spanish tax agency (AEAT).

verifactu.enableHelp: Once on, a sale cannot be paid without its record.
verifactu.envHelp: Test and production keep separate chains.
verifactu.notCertifiedBody: Ahemad's Restro has not been run against the live AEAT portal and NODEDR has not issued its Declaración Responsable. Test with AEAT’s pre-production portal and ask your gestor before relying on it.
verifactu.recordsEmpty: Records appear here as sales are paid.
verifactu.spainOnly: VERI*FACTU applies only to branches in Spain. Set this branch’s country to Spain (and its tax regime to Spain – IVA) under General to use it.

webhooks.verifyBody: Reject anything older than five minutes. Failed deliveries are retried up to 6 times (1 min, 5 min, 30 min, 2 h, 12 h). Respond with any 2xx to accept.
webhooks.verifyIntro: Each request has an X-OrderRestro-Signature header, where v1 is the HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp and raw body, signed with your signing secret:
